key: I had a nice house on the west side of town, once.
en: I had a nice house on the west side of town, once.
ja: 昔は、街の西側にいい家を持っていたんだ。

key: Two kids.
en: Two kids.
ja: 子供も二人いた。

key: There is no west side of town anymore.
en: There is no west side of town anymore.
ja: 今はもう、街の西側なんてない。

key: There are no kids.
en: There are no kids.
ja: 子供たちもいない。

key: Can't you spare a bit of change?
en: Can't you spare a bit of change?
ja: 小銭を少し分けてもらえないか?

key: \G...Really? How much?
en: \G...Really? How much?
ja: \G……本当か? いくらだ?

key: You... have given me quite a lot, huh.
en: You... have given me quite a lot, huh.
ja: あんた……ずいぶん、くれたんだな。

key: ...Thank you, stranger.
en: ...Thank you, stranger.
ja: ……ありがとう、見知らぬ人。

key: The money is important.
en: The money is important.
ja: 金は大事だ。

key: It'll keep me alive.
en: It'll keep me alive.
ja: それで生きていける。

key: But it won't give me the strength to move forward.
en: But it won't give me the strength to move forward.
ja: だが、前へ進む力はくれない。

key: You did that.
en: You did that.
ja: それをくれたのは、あんただ。

key: ...I want you to have this.
en: ...I want you to have this.
ja: ……これを受け取ってほしい。

key: It's kind of a good luck charm.
en: It's kind of a good luck charm.
ja: ちょっとしたお守りみたいなものだ。

key: Give it to your Pokémon.
en: Give it to your Pokémon.
ja: あんたのポケモンに持たせてやってくれ。

key: It might invite new things into your life too.
en: It might invite new things into your life too.
ja: あんたの人生にも、何か新しいものを呼び込んでくれるかもしれない。

key: ...Thanks.
en: ...Thanks.
ja: ……ありがとよ。

key: It's better than nothing.
en: It's better than nothing.
ja: 何もないよりはましだ。

key: ...You shouldn't give what you don't have.
en: ...You shouldn't give what you don't have.
ja: ……持っていないものを、渡しちゃだめだ。

key: The thought is nice, but hold onto what you still have while you can.
en: The thought is nice, but hold onto what you still have while you can.
ja: 気持ちはうれしいが、まだ手元にあるうちは、それを大事に持っておきなさい。

key: They say disasters like forest fires are good for the growth of the forest.
en: They say disasters like forest fires are good for the growth of the forest.
ja: 山火事のような災害は、森の成長にはいいことだって言うだろう。

key: I suppose it's the same even when the forest is itself the disaster.
en: I suppose it's the same even when the forest is itself the disaster.
ja: 森そのものが災害になったときも、同じことなのかもな。

key: Is it for our growth, then?
en: Is it for our growth, then?
ja: それじゃあ、これは俺たちの成長のためだっていうのか?

key: Did you hear all that shaking?
en: Did you hear all that shaking?
ja: あの揺れ、聞こえたか?

key: What's going on?
en: What's going on?
ja: 一体何が起きてるんだ?

key: First we lose half of the ward-- what else could be next!?
en: First we lose half of the ward-- what else could be next!?
ja: まず区の半分を失って――次は一体何だっていうんだ!?

key: A whole squad of officers just charged into the Beryl Gym.
en: A whole squad of officers just charged into the Beryl Gym.
ja: 警官の一隊が、ベリルジムに突入していったぞ。

key: And this is right after all those tremors...
en: And this is right after all those tremors...
ja: あの揺れの直後にな……

key: Did you see the Rhodochrine Tree on your way in?
en: Did you see the Rhodochrine Tree on your way in?
ja: 来る途中、ロドクラインの樹を見たか?

key: It only grew like that just recently-- like some artificial force was making it grow!
en: It only grew like that just recently-- like some artificial force was making it grow!
ja: あんなふうに育ったのは最近のことでな――まるで何か人工的な力で成長させられているみたいだった!

key: But no complaints here; it's quite the view!
en: But no complaints here; it's quite the view!
ja: まあ、文句はないさ。なかなかの眺めだからな!

key: They all just stormed the old Gym Leader's house...
en: They all just stormed the old Gym Leader's house...
ja: 皆して、あの元ジムリーダーの家に押しかけていったよ……

key: He's not the most friendly person, but he's always helped when we needed it.
en: He's not the most friendly person, but he's always helped when we needed it.
ja: あまり愛想のいい奴じゃないが、必要なときにはいつも力を貸してくれた男だ。

key: I wonder what he's gotten himself into now...
en: I wonder what he's gotten himself into now...
ja: 今度は一体何に巻き込まれてるんだか……

key: <- Little Poe Street\n^v - Platinum Street
en: <- Little Poe Street\n^v - Platinum Street
ja: <- リトルポー通り\n^v - プラチナ通り

en: <- Kingsbury Street\nv - Emerald Street
ja: <- キングズベリー通り\nv - エメラルド通り

key: Hello, Trainer!
en: Hello, Trainer!
ja: こんにちは、トレーナーさん!

key: Can I interest you in buying a pack of PokéSnax?
en: Can I interest you in buying a pack of PokéSnax?
ja: ポケスナックをひと袋、いかがですか?

key: PokéSnax are a delicious treat for your Pokémon! Feeding your Pokémon PokéSnax will make them that much happier!
en: PokéSnax are a delicious treat for your Pokémon!  Feeding your Pokémon PokéSnax will make them that much happier!
ja: ポケスナックは、ポケモンのためのおいしいおやつです! 食べさせてあげれば、ポケモンはもっと幸せになりますよ!

key: But that's not at all!
en: But that's not at all!
ja: でも、それだけじゃないんです!

key: Just by having these delicious, nutritious sweet treats to eat, rare wild Pokémon will be more likely to approach you!
en: Just by having these delicious, nutritious sweet treats to eat, rare wild Pokémon will be more likely to approach you!
ja: このおいしくて栄養満点のおやつを持っているだけで、珍しい野生のポケモンが近づいてきやすくなるんですよ!

key: Nawwwh, I don't mean random encounters in the grass- who would want that?
en: Nawwwh, I don't mean random encounters in the grass- who would want that?
ja: いやいや、草むらでのランダムな遭遇のことじゃないですよ、そんなの誰が求めます?

key: I mean on special occasions, other Pokémon may approach you that wouldn't normally. So what to do you say?
en: I mean on special occasions, other Pokémon may approach you that wouldn't normally. So what to do you say?
ja: 特別な機会に、普段は現れないポケモンが近づいてくることがあるって話です。どうです?

key: Care to buy up some Snax?
en: Care to buy up some Snax?
ja: スナックをお買い上げになりませんか?

key: I mean on special occasions other Pokémon may approach you that wouldn't normally. So what to do you say?
en: I mean on special occasions other Pokémon may approach you that wouldn't normally. So what to do you say?
ja: 特別な機会に、普段は現れないポケモンが近づいてくることがあるって話です。どうです?

key: <- Stoker Road\n^ - Platinum Street\n>- Beryl Bridge
en: <- Stoker Road\n^ - Platinum Street\n>- Beryl Bridge
ja: <- ストーカー通り\n^ - プラチナ通り\n>- ベリル大橋

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
